cases.title: 长会话：定位最后一个成功压缩点
command: history from the latest completed compaction matches the full transcript cut there|history never decodes rows before the latest compaction or its kept tail
cases.observation: 有失败记录时仍采用上一份成功检查点，keepID 尾部参与窗口，窗口前旧行不进入模型读取。

cases.title: 切换模型：回退到兼容的检查点
command: falls back to an earlier compatible native or local checkpoint|skips a malformed native window
cases.observation: 遇到不兼容或无法解码的原生窗口时，读取路径回退并保留可发送历史。

cases.title: 长会话中途改项目指令
command: keeps the initial instructions stable and derives a chronological update from values|moves the epoch at compaction and narrates later changes
cases.observation: 未压缩时初始指令保持稳定，新增变化按时序叙述；压缩完成后新的指令 epoch 接管。

cases.title: 从阈值前一 Token 到刚好达到阈值
command: auto compaction estimates current content against the buffered prompt ceiling
cases.observation: 模型输入上限、缓冲配置和累计估计决定是否进入自动压缩；普通输出上限变化不等于阈值变化。

cases.title: 摘要请求的输入与回复空间
command: summary compaction past the ceiling keeps the conversation unchanged|compaction lowers the output limit when it sends a request it could not shrink|compaction keeps the output limit for a request that fits
cases.observation: 压缩已触发时仍可沿用能装下的完整请求，放不下时另行缩减且可能调整摘要输出上限。

cases.title: 提前写摘要，到阈值后再换入
command: automatic compaction swaps in the background summary without another model call|a background summary starts a fixed lead before the threshold|a background summary starts on a window whose threshold is under
cases.observation: 后台预生成和正式换入分开；符合条件时，换入已有摘要无需再调用一次摘要模型。

cases.title: 长会话不断追加，摘要和近期原话怎样更新
command: automatically compacts into a completed summary and retained recent turn
cases.observation: 第一次接续带摘要和近期原话，下一次摘要请求可读到上一份摘要和保留的尾部。

cases.title: 模型服务商判溢出，运行时如何重试
command: forces one compaction and retries after provider context overflow|does not recover provider context overflow when automatic compaction is disabled
cases.observation: 有恢复条件时，原请求之后出现摘要请求与接续请求。禁用自动压缩时不进入该恢复路径。

cases.title: 超窗时先缩工具输出
command: drops tool output in serialized compaction history before omitting exchanges
cases.observation: 摘要请求降级为可裁剪文本时，优先缩减工具输出，再考虑更早的完整轮次。

cases.title: 原生压缩与下一次 HTTP 请求
command: manual trigger persists and continues, retains earlier users repeatedly|manual and automatic endpoint compaction keep the provider replacement unchanged|automatic native failures, interruptions, and overflows retain the checkpoint
cases.observation: 真实协议编译器生成原生检查点输入，当前指令和新用户请求依然可见，失败时保留此前检查点。
